name: key-takeaways
title: Key takeaways
description: A summary box for the top of a long article: three to five takeaways, reading time, intended audience and up to three jump links.
docs: Pass three to five points, short enough to read in ten seconds. minutes, audience and jumps fill the footer; give it any of them, and up to three jumps are shown, each an anchor to a section of the article. The box is a section labelled by its own heading (title, an h2 unless you set headingLevel), so assistive technology lists it as a landmark and can skip to it or past it. That is the difference from Callout, which is not a landmark. Pass labels to translate the reading time, the audience words and the jump label.
